hits.snippet: House of Student Raises $2 Million to Expand AI Housing Marketplace ... House of Student has raised $2 million in seed funding through equity and debt to accelerate product development, AI capabilities and international expansion. Saltwater Sutra, a New York-Mumbai investment-banking group, led the financing alongside Nirmitsu Inspirational Ventures. Participants included Gautam Verlekar, Glen Fernandes, Richard McCallum, Ali Moosa and other strategic investors, while existing Unilodgers investors maintained their support. The San Francisco-based technology company operates a student-housing marketplace containing more than 2.5 million verified rooms across over 25 countries. Its coverage includes the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, United Arab Emirates, Singapore and 18 European nations. The capital will support platform improvements and broader market penetration as the company scales its global student-living marketplace and AI-driven services worldwide.
